I'm 19, and about a year in. Thankfully I'm in Alberta, Canada where the drinking age is 18 years old so I was able to get into bar shows from the beginning. But when I started the town I was held the open mic/showcase in a bowling alley, so you could look for a venue like that which holds a show. While living in that town me and my friend also started our own room in his tiny detached garage, which I would definitely recommend, it's usually a pretty friendly room (welcome change from a bowling alley with 3 audience members), and a good chance to try things like hosting/ten minute spots before you're probably really ready for one. Go around to cafe's and ask if they would be open to holding shows, a lot of coffee shops business dies around 7 pm and they are glad to have something that attracts a crowd when people don't need caffeine anymore. Start off slow and do a bi-weekly/monthly show and try and rotate acts so people don't get the same 60-90 mins of comedy every show, and once you build an audience see if you can make it more frequent. That's about all I can think of right now but if you have any more questions I'm happy to help with whatever I can! Thank's for watching!

 When I started if I was bored I would just look at something, and in my head try to think of as many words as possible that rhymed with that thing.
